verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents a quickstart that completes 'a minimal end-to-end online payment in the sandbox' using Airwallex.js and the hosted payment page. It backs this with instant self-serve sandbox signup, drop-in element configuration via createElement, an airwallex-dev skill that generates integration code, and AI-agent integration notes steering developers to the current SDK. However, nothing in the evidence shows copy-paste samples across multiple server-side languages, and nothing independent confirms a sub-day integration. missing for 10: evidence of multi-language copy-paste code samples/SDKs, hands-on or independent corroboration of under-a-day time-to-first-payment.
